title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-18
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX 100) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 96KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP4 shotgun caps -> Sony TC-D5M ("1st two nights we were up on the lawn shooting at the repeater stacks from very close range")

ai_review.summary: Audience tape praised for its lively capture, but some listeners balk at heavy noise‑reduction processing.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally regarded as a solid audience source taken from the repeater stacks, offering an authentic Alpine vibe that many reviewers find enjoyable. However, one reviewer feels the applied noise reduction overwhelms the sound, while another explains the apparent phasing is due to stack delay rather than processing. No specific musical performance details were mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Four reviews give a spread of opinions (0, 4, 4, 5 stars). The majority are positive about the recording’s capture, but one strong negative comment on noise reduction drags the overall impression down, resulting in an average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured from repeater stacks (line‑in), praised for lively ambience. Some listeners note excessive noise reduction that muddies the mix, while others attribute phasing to stack delay rather than processing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on performance or set structure were provided.
